questions.question: What priorities has Brightwater announced for billing data?
How does Veridian Checks approach data testing?
Which regulatory changes affect billing data controls?
Has Brightwater published its data platform vendor list?

entries.claim: Brightwater Utilities announced a billing accuracy program for 2027.
entries.quote: Brightwater will launch a billing accuracy program in 2027 covering all customer accounts.

entries.claim: Veridian Checks is a rule-based data testing tool where engineers write tests table by table.
entries.quote: Veridian Checks lets data engineers define tests for each table in code.

entries.claim: State regulators now expect utilities to document their billing data controls.
entries.quote: Utilities must document the controls that protect the accuracy of billing data.
